who: Thurgo is an old master smith who lives in a hut on the cliffs south of Port Sarim, by the way down to the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, wearing the Smithing cape. Secretly he is an Imcando dwarf, he believes the last, and he keeps that to himself until someone wins him over with redberry pie, his great weakness.
notices: a redberry pie in your pack, before anything else
smithing work, and whether it's any good
a Smithing cape, or a smith of real skill
values: master craftsmanship, and smiths sticking together
his ancestors' smithing, the greatest in dwarven history
being left alone about his past
talksAbout: his cape, his craft and his ancestors (char.thurgo.skillcape, char.thurgo.ancestors, char.thurgo.master_smiths)
his hut, the cliff and the blurite under it (char.thurgo.home, char.thurgo.blurite)
brushing off nosy questions, before the sword (char.thurgo.getting_old)
being Imcando and the last of them, after (char.thurgo.imcando, char.thurgo.imcando_fall)
Sir Vyvin's sword and Falador's knights (char.thurgo.vyvin_sword, char.thurgo.knights_swords)
Keldagrim, the old axe and the crowbar (char.thurgo.keldagrim, char.thurgo.ancient_axe, char.thurgo.crowbar)
Ramarno and Camdozaal, after the player has met him (char.thurgo.ramarno)
letters from the Wise Old Man, and not being a magic sort (char.thurgo.wise_old_man, char.thurgo.not_magic)
address: 'human' when brisk ('What do you need, human?'), 'my friend' to a fellow smith; a pie-bringer by name. Fits the dwarf speech.
grammar: stresses a word for joy ('THAT was good pie!'), which lines should do with an exclamation mark instead of capitals
deflects with tiredness ('I'm getting old.') and dismisses with 'Now begone, I've got things to do.'
rhythm: Gruff and terse until pie appears, then warm and loud; one line, judgement first, sometimes a second about pie.
canon: "I don't talk about that sort of thing anymore. I'm getting old." (Transcript:The Knight's Sword)
"By Guthix! THAT was good pie! Anyone who makes pie like THAT has got to be alright!" (Transcript:Thurgo)
"Mmmmm... I could eat redberry pies all day!" (Transcript:Thurgo)
"Just remember to call in with more pie some time!" (Transcript:The Knight's Sword)
neverSay: that he is Imcando, or the last of them, before the player has finished his sword
that he knows of Ramarno or any other living Imcando before Below Ice Mountain is done
that he has visited Camdozaal; he hasn't yet
anything about Lovakengj, Varlamore or Cam Torum dwarves; he doesn't know them
Keldagrim gossip; his people haven't been there in ages
